method.runtime: Local Ollama0.40.13; existing imported Q4_K_M weights
method.storage: Disposable copies of saved database and workbook fixtures
method.iteration_scope: Model cases and freshness-boundary checks were collected across development iterations. Final source parity was checked by deterministic renderer replay and by replaying the actual ordinal model JSON through the final Telegram/application delivery path with verified publications and a current schedule checkpoint; that last replay was not a new model generation.

actual_model_cases.case: Correct a previously discussed threshold from 19.5 to 18.5
actual_model_cases.manual_review: Passed. Retained player, points market, side and game date; acknowledged the new and superseded user thresholds without treating the superseded value as a statistic.

actual_model_cases.case: Explain the second item from a real generated research list
actual_model_cases.manual_review: Passed after the narrow consistency guard. Selected Karl-Anthony Towns/PRA rather than the second conditional threshold; retained hypothetical research status and did not claim measured consistency or current performance.

actual_model_cases.case: Explain a mixed user-priced line and unpriced research target
actual_model_cases.manual_review: Passed. Kept both players and markets, distinguished a user-provided points line from a hypothetical PRA research projection, and did not invent a verified offer or betting edge.

final_transport_replay.path: telegram_answer → application/chat_flow → current-source-card validation → post-generation readiness recheck

renderer_replays.note: These are deterministic checks of previously captured real-model outputs, not additional generations.

freshness_boundary_checks.inputs: Cached publications with no verified current-day source check
freshness_boundary_checks.result: Held: latest completed team game lacks a current publication check.

freshness_boundary_checks.inputs: Same stale latest-game publication plus an independently verified prior-day off day
freshness_boundary_checks.result: Still held. A verified off day does not make the earlier game publication current.

freshness_boundary_checks.inputs: Actually fetched and independently verified latest-game publication plus verified prior-day off day
freshness_boundary_checks.phase: This intermediate check preceded the independent current-schedule requirement.
freshness_boundary_checks.result: Latest game-observation readiness passed. Under the final implementation, recommendations additionally require the current schedule check described in the next case.

freshness_boundary_checks.inputs: Those verified observations plus an actual current-day schedule response replayed at its original check time
freshness_boundary_checks.result: Current schedule matched the existing upcoming NYK–CHI event. The research list remained partial.

current_schedule.method: Parsed the captured actual HTTP body with its original fetched_at; did not advance the timestamp to make it fresh.

issues_discovered_and_corrected: Retired user thresholds in correction acknowledgments were falsely rejected as unsupported statistics.
Ordinal followups needed explicit selected-player context to avoid choosing a conditional threshold instead.
Projection summaries must not be promoted to observed consistency or current-condition facts.
Mixed priced and research explanations must keep all requested identities and their separate meanings.
Readiness required actual current publication coverage, independent schedule freshness, and another check after generation.
Real SQLite row access and the real-clock call in the post-generation check needed runtime fixes.
limits: No live Akash deployment or external Telegram delivery was exercised.
A completed readiness check concerns game observations and the checked game schedule; injuries, tracking metrics and tentative defenders retain separate source dates and uncertainty.
The available research list lacked a supported CHI selection, so it was not a complete two-team entry.
Observed local timings ranged from about 22 to 64 seconds for these accepted cases and do not guarantee provider latency.
The tests do not establish perfect future accuracy, calibrated probabilities or guaranteed results.

data_relay_run.note: Existing statistics and tracking publications were refreshed. Independent ESPN inventory access failed on this GitHub runner; a successful job does not establish complete independent inventory verification.

verified_offday_publication.inventory_scope: Independent ESPN NBA day inventory; existing workbook player rows only
verified_offday_publication.publication_note: Independently fetched from ESPN in the validation environment and published with its actual verification timestamp; no player statistics invented.

changes: Missing per-date checks run once immediately after the daily deadline when upgrading from an old worker; failed checks retain the hourly cooldown.
Freshness output shows safe current schedule failure categories without requiring a full status dump.

verification_published.note: Existing published inventory matched all 15 final games from the independently fetched ESPN scoreboard. Original source statistics and publication timestamps are preserved.

startup_followup.deployment_note: Actual Akash current schedule access remains unverified; CI success does not establish production source readiness.
